# devin_knowledge_folders (Data Source)

Lists the knowledge folders in an organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "devin_knowledge_folders" "all" {
  org_id = var.org_id
}

resource "devin_knowledge_note" "backend" {
  org_id    = var.org_id
  name      = "Backend knowledge"
  body      = "Knowledge for the backend team."
  trigger   = "When working on backend code"
  folder_id = data.devin_knowledge_folders.all.folder_ids_by_path["Engineering/Backend"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `org_id` (String) Organization ID that owns these knowledge folders.

### Read-Only

- `folder_ids_by_path` (Map of String) Knowledge folder IDs keyed by their path.
- `folders` (Attributes List) Knowledge folders in the organization. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--folders))
- `root_note_count` (Number) Number of knowledge notes in the organization root.

<a id="nestedatt--folders"></a>
### Nested Schema for `folders`

Read-Only:

- `folder_id` (String) Knowledge folder ID.
- `name` (String) Knowledge folder name.
- `note_count` (Number) Number of knowledge notes in the folder.
- `parent_folder_id` (String) Parent knowledge folder ID, or null for a root folder.
- `path` (String) Knowledge folder path.
